full_details: Before you went down, the page was still one page. At Old Swan Stairs half the parish stood for the new Mayor going by water to take his oath. Gannet, on his oars, gave you three news and would not follow the barge. Kemp took his hat off toward Bishopsgate. Mistress Ansell said Sir John went out as he came in. A woman's dark head turned away, laughing, and you did not look long enough to know who stood beside her. You wrote down one line, played Egeon, and at the west window saw the oriel of Crosby Place dark, with no halberds at the gate. You did not go down. You put a small cross in the almanac and no name beside it.
one_sentence: You kept one line from the river and played Egeon at two.
title: One line at Old Swan, and Egeon
